solution: Check file version and independent backup coverage; recovering any file does not prove the intended current version is recoverable. Practise a safe verified restore with a non-sensitive sample, never private documents.
explanation: Assess the observable output against every essential criterion. A safe justified refusal or a named unresolved gap can meet the criterion; invented certainty cannot.
